column1: # KISS-Conform 6.14: coordinates with no discriminating pair in a vector file (KISS#240, #239 item 3).
# <vector file> TAB <field index> TAB <category> TAB <reason>   (tools/kiss_pairs.py; fields in its FIELDS)
# undiscriminated = no pair can be constructed (6.14-0002, the reason says why).
# unauthored      = a pair is constructible but absent: recorded debt (6.14-0004), a row is removed when
#                   the pair is authored and the tool fails while a row outlives its gap.
# Measured over 31 positive vectors (28 + the three 6.14 pair vectors).

column4: Single-valued by construction: field 0 names the grammar (sk7); another value is a different grammar, not a legal sk7 input.

No two vectors differ in reduce alone, and none may be constructible: the keepdim mask on the output operand records the reduced axes (6.6-0009), so reduce may not vary independently of operands. Settle by authoring a legal pair, or move this row to undiscriminated with that proof.
